import trimesh, numpy as np
m = trimesh.load('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl')
# measure radial wall thickness at several heights: intersect ray from outside inward
for z in [6,10,12.2,14.6,17.5,20]:
    o=np.array([48.,0.,z]); d=np.array([-1.,0.,0.])
    locs,ray,tri = m.ray.intersects_location([o],[d],multiple_hits=True)
    xs=sorted([float(l[0]) for l in locs])
    print(f"z={z}: intersections x={np.round(xs,2)} innermost_wall_thickness={xs[-1]-xs[-2] if len(xs)>=2 else None}")
